C1409.title: South Korea Sets DeFi Precedent with First DEX Rug Pull Criminal Case
C1409.summary: The Seoul Southern District Prosecutors' Office filed South Korea's first criminal case involving a decentralized exchange rug pull, indicting five suspects (two detained and three non-detained). The suspects were charged with manipulating the CATFI token market on the Solana-based DEX and executing a rug pull that caused combined losses of 900 million won for 256 investors, while illicitly profiting about 400 million won.
